name: Back cover
description: The outer shell on the back of the phone. It protects the inside and, on many phones, helps keep water and dust out.
commonSymptoms: Cracked or shattered back
Back lifting away from the frame, which can mean a swollen battery
Rattling or a loose corner
tools: Heat pad or heat gun on low
safetyNotes: Wear eye protection. Glass can break suddenly while you pry.
If the back is lifting by itself, stop and check for a swollen battery.

name: Battery
description: A flat lithium-ion pouch that stores the phone's power. It connects to the mainboard through a small press-on connector.
commonSymptoms: Battery drains very quickly
Phone shuts off with charge still showing
Battery or back of the phone looks swollen
Phone gets hot while charging
safetyNotes: Never puncture, bend or crush a battery. It can catch fire.
Never use metal tools to pry a battery.
Never reuse or keep charging a swollen battery.

name: Mainboard
description: The main circuit board. It holds the processor, memory and the connectors that link every other part together.
commonSymptoms: Phone will not turn on, even with a good battery
Random restarts
No signal or no Wi-Fi after a drop or water damage
safetyNotes: Disconnect the battery before touching the board.
Static electricity can damage chips, so ground yourself first.

name: Rear camera
description: The camera module on the back of the phone. It plugs into the mainboard with its own small connector.
commonSymptoms: Blurry photos
Camera app shows a black screen
Spots that appear in every photo
safetyNotes: Do not touch the lens with bare fingers.
Keep heat away from the camera area.

name: Charging flex
description: A thin ribbon or small board that carries the charging port, and often the microphone. A long flex cable links it to the mainboard.
commonSymptoms: Phone only charges at a certain cable angle
Charging is very slow
Computer does not detect the phone
Microphone sounds faint in calls
tools: Soft brush for cleaning the port
safetyNotes: Check for lint in the port before replacing anything. Clean it with a non-metal tool.

name: Display
description: The screen assembly, which combines the glass, the touch layer and the panel that makes the picture. This view shows its inside face.
commonSymptoms: Cracked glass
Black patches or colored lines
Touch does not respond in some areas
Screen stays black but the phone still makes sounds
tools: Heat pad or heat gun on low
safetyNotes: Cracked glass is sharp. Wear gloves and eye protection.
Do not bend the panel or pull on its cable.
